definition:
D = u_range + 0.25*[CE flips] + 0.25*[R flips] + 0.25*[judge flip]
  u_range = max u - min u over every judged condition of the item (pack sets, models, seeds, hosts, phone);
  CE / R flips = the label is not the same in every condition; judge flip = Haiku vs Opus CE label differs, or |corr_H - corr_O| >= 1.5,
  on any answer where both exist. D is NaN with < 2 judged conditions.

divergent-main.note: top 30 of MAIN 97 by D, live items only

divergent-st180.note: top 40 of the 180 self-tests by D, live items only

divergent-v01.note: top 20 of the 72 v0.1 phone ids by D, phone-live items only

divergent-pool.note: union main + st180 (for run_pool.sh, any order)

deterministic-v01.note: phone: identical text and 0 generated tokens on 1.7B, Gemma and 4B (warm-up included); skip on phone runs

deterministic-pool.note: desktop: 0 tokens on K0+K1 controls and one text across all desktop conditions

deterministic_judge_noise.note: deterministic items: one answer text in every condition, so u_range here is pure judge test-retest noise (Haiku re-judging identical text across runs)
